bullets: Prepared and reviewed financial statements in accordance with Schedule III of the Companies Act, 2013.
Tested revenue recognition as per IND AS 115/ AS 9, including cut-off procedures and substantive testing.
Assisted in drafting and reporting of matters pertaining to auditee’s Financial Statement as per SA 700,705, and reporting under CARO 2020.

Checked and verified capitalization, depreciation and disclosure of PPE as per IND AS-16 and AS 10 read with Statutory schedule II of Companies Act, 2013. Audit • Handled tax and regulatory audits, including drafting and review of Tax Audit Reports u/s 44AB (Forms 3CA/3CB & 3CD) and verification of compliance under Income Tax and GST laws.
Assisted in statutory audit of bank branches, including verification of advances, loan documentation, interest income, and asset classification.
Reviewed NPA identification and provisioning in compliance with RBI guidelines using core banking systems.
Filed Tax Audit Reports with annexures in Form 3CD in compliance with the provisions of the Income Tax Act.
Opined on legal matters to determine eligibility and blocked credits under section 16 and 17(5) of GST Act, 2017.

Filed GSTR-3B and GSTR-9 returns for corporate and non-corporate clients across various industries Taxation including manufacturing, trading, and service sectors. (Direct & • Identified discrepancies while reconciling GSTR2B and ITC as per records and resolved via vendor Indirect) coordination.

Advised clients on the applicability of TDS provisions and assisted in determining the appropriate timing for TDS deduction, fostering proactive tax management strategies and optimizing financial outcomes.

Prepared and filed over 100 income tax returns ranging from ₹1 to ₹50 crore for diverse clients, including Individuals, Partnership Firms, and Private Limited Companies, ensuring accuracy and compliance with tax regulations.
Extensive practical exposure to various issues in GST audit, Reconciliation, returns, registration, cancellation etc.

Maintained and reviewed books of accounts, including journal entries, ledgers, trial balance, and vendor/customer reconciliations, ensuring compliance with accounting standards and internal controls. Finance & • Handled Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable processes, including invoice validation, ageing analysis, Accounting inter-company reconciliations, and month-end closing support.
Assisted in the preparation of monthly MIS and financial statements (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow) and performed variance analysis for management reporting.
Aided clients in saving ₹1.2 Lac through business consultation pertaining to effective treasury, wealth & investment management.
Technical Skills: Proficient in MS Office Suite, Tally ERP 9, Tally Prime, Compu office Financial Modelling (Pursuing), Power BI (Pursuing).
